newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - March 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - March 29.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The government is considering legal actions against the brokers, dealers and listed companies which were involved in the recent capital market scam, official sources said.
Malaria fever has claimed more than 2,500 lives in the three hill districts -- Rangamati, Bandarbans and Khagrachari-- and the adjacent coastal district of Cox's Bazar during the last seven year
The country's 75 percent of the nine million hectres of farmland has substamtially lost fertility due to improper use of chemical fertiliser.
Secretary General of the State Council of China Lua Gan arrives in Dhaka on Saturday on a three-day visit to Bangladesh.
Former President Hussain Moahammad Ershad on Friday called upon the government to seek people's consent befor allowing trade corridor to India.
U.S. Ambassador in Dhaka David N Merrill on Friday lauded the present state of human rights in Bangladesh.
About 300,000 Bangladeshi are working illegally in Malaysia.
The report of the Local Governemnt Commission has been finalised and expected to be submitted to the government soon.
